text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"longer connected sentences with multiple ideas linked by 'because', 'when', 'then', 'while'","quality":"syntactic complexity","description":"Uses more extended sentence structures to connect ideas and events within and across sentences."},{"evidence":"clear sequence of playing soccer, picnic, then games, then eating","quality":"organization","description":"Presents ideas in a more orderly progression that is easier to follow overall."},{"evidence":"'we gather around', 'we do a picnic', 'we play some short game'","quality":"descriptive detail","description":"Includes more concrete activity details that make the writing more vivid and specific."},{"evidence":"'tell scary tails', 'get creep out', 'joyful to me'","quality":"expressive word choice","description":"Shows somewhat stronger range of vocabulary and more expressive phrasing."},{"evidence":"fewer repeated 'think first' and 'bad chose' patterns","quality":"developmental control","description":"Maintains a more sustained flow of writing with less dependence on a single repeated point."}]}
